mechanism_summary: Pre-register XAUUSD gold trend-following screening before WFA execution.
instrument_scope: XAUUSD M15 source data with H4-style strategy profile, FTMO/MT5-listed Metals CFD by terminal universe evidence, research-only until MT5 data equivalence is proven.
timeframe_candidate: M15 data with H4 strategy profile
expected_trade_frequency: Medium frequency; no low-frequency exception is registered and the default 200-trade floor applies.
data_sources: FTMO terminal universe snapshot lists XAUUSD, but MT5 data equivalence is not assumed.
cost_assumptions: Use only gold_trend_following WFA config costs: fees 0.0001 and slippage 0.0001, no hidden overrides.

wfa_design.window_policy: Use the canonical 12m training / 3m testing / 3m step WFA scheme encoded in the config.
wfa_design.optimizer_policy: Use the existing 80-trial route and count this attempt in the denominator.

invalidation_criteria: Reject as non-survivor if real WFA fails any Phase 8D survivor floor on completed OOS windows, total trades, return proxy, or positive OOS window ratio.
Reject any deployment or Phase 8E implication unless a separate survivor exists with MT5 instrument equivalence and explicit operator authorization.
Treat any post-result change to symbol, timeframe, cost, parameter space, or WFA config as a new denominator-tracked attempt.
